import sys, os

import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

@click.command()
@click.option("--port", type=int)
def cli(port):
    click.echo(f"port={port}")

# resolve_envvar_value with prefix set on context
with click.Context(cli, auto_envvar_prefix="APP") as ctx:
    param = cli.params[0]
    os.environ.pop("APP_PORT", None)
    os.environ.pop("APP__PORT", None)
    print("explicit envvar attr:", param.envvar)
    os.environ["APP__PORT"] = "1234"
    print("resolved:", param.resolve_envvar_value(ctx))
    os.environ.pop("APP__PORT")
    os.environ["APP_PORT"] = "5678"
    print("resolved (single underscore):", param.resolve_envvar_value(ctx))
    os.environ.pop("APP_PORT")
EOF
